verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a broad programmatic surface. It covers checkout creation (hosted and embedded), full and partial refunds, Cloud API control of readers including pairing and naming multiple Solos, a JS SDK, API keys acting on the merchant account, and a managed MCP server for account management and payments. A developer also built a receipt-printer integration via the public API. However, nothing documents parity with the UI: webhooks only report checkout status changes, POS-tier features like customer rewards and automated marketing have no API evidence, and no OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of POS and marketing/rewards features, webhook events beyond checkout status, a discoverable full API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of parity.
